paper_title: Search for Dark Photon Dark Matter: Dark E-Field Radio Pilot Experiment
coupling_convention: kinetic mixing epsilon (dimensionless); plot shows log10(epsilon), values emitted as epsilon
notes: Pilot experiment measured 5-sigma exclusion limits on dark photon kinetic mixing over 50-300 MHz (2.07e-7 to 1.24e-6 eV). The broadband pilot limit (~eps ~1e-12, blue curve Fig. 9/12, 3.8 hr integration) is encoded as a two-point flat bound over the validity range; the exact curve varies roughly between log10(eps) = -11.5 and -12.5 and is only available from figures. One explicit numerical spot limit from text: eps < 6.4e-13 at 70.5 MHz (10^6 s integration, 5 sigma). Additional spot checks at 63.9, 152, and 247 MHz shown in figures without numerical values. Paper also contains Phase-I/Phase-II projections (down to eps ~1e-13 to 1e-15), which are NOT included in data_points. Note the confidence level is actually 5 sigma, higher than the 0.95 reported here. DM density assumed 380 TeV/m^3 = 0.38 GeV/cm^3.
